entities.summary: Matthew William Thomas is an American professional basketball player for Beşiktaş Gain of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and EuroCup. He played college basketball for the Iowa State Cyclones before starting his professional career in Europe, then moving to the National Basketball Association (NBA), and back to Europe again.
